Bill.BriefDescription: Addressing the time and date when posting credit card payments made in person.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to making credit card payments in person; adding anew section to chapter 30.04 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 31.12RCW; adding a new section to chapter 32.04 RCW; and adding a newsection to chapter 33.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 30.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: All payments made in person at the issuing bank, or any of itssubsidiaries or branches, shall be considered payment to the issuer andshall be posted on the day received and at the time of day in the bank,subsidiary, or branch at which the payment is made.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 31.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: All payments made in person at the issuing credit union, or any ofits branches, shall be considered payment to the issuer and shall beposted on the day received and at the time of day in the credit unionor branch at which the payment is made.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 32.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: All payments made in person at the issuing savings bank, or any ofits subsidiaries or branches, shall be considered payment to the issuerand shall be posted on the day received and at the time of day in thesavings bank, subsidiary, or branch at which the payment is made.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 33.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: All payments made in person at the issuing savings association, orany of its subsidiaries or branches, shall be considered payment to theissuer and shall be posted on the day received and at the time of dayin the savings association, subsidiary, or branch at which the paymentis made.
